title: se-implementation-scratchpad-glacier-asset-management
content:
Glacier Asset Management - SE implementation scratchpad

Context:
- Customer: Glacier Asset Management (large wealth manager, strict data residency)
- Goal: Private deployment (VPC + customer-managed control plane) for model hosting of chat + embeddings.
- Priority: Data isolation + auditability, latency in EU-West region, KMS integration for keys, move to Dedicated after POC.

Meeting notes (2026-02-20 sync w/ Infra + Customer Sec):
- Customer insists on HSM-backed keys (YubiHSM + AWS CloudHSM option). They will prefer CloudHSM but want HSM integration tested in staging.
- Networking: prefer VPC Peering with transit gateway. Need CIDR ranges: Glacier will provide 10.10.0.0/16 for app, 10.11.0.0/16 for infra.
- Compliance: retention of audit logs for 18 months (Redwood default 90d). Need uplift request.
- Timeline: POC in 3 weeks, production in ~8 weeks after approval.

High-level POC checklist (top-down):
- [ ] Create customer-specific VPC in eu-west-1 (tag: glacier-prod-poc)
- [ ] Request KMS/CloudHSM access & test key wrapping (owner: Marco, due 2026-02-25)
- [ ] Provision private control plane endpoint (customer-subnet + security groups)
- [ ] Configure model catalog access: pin to gpt-3.5-compatible open model, quantized 4-bit variant for cost (temp)
- [ ] Implement prefix KV caching on 2 hot routes (chat and embeddings); tune cache size baseline 1GB
- [ ] Set up audit logging export to Glacier S3 bucket (lifecycle 540 days) -> legal signoff
- [ ] Run simple latency test (50 concurrent users) and collect 95p latency

Quick network/security implementation notes:
- CIDR planning: request confirmation on overlapping with their existing peering with vendor X. If overlap -> provision NAT + transit gateway route table workaround.
- Security groups: allow inbound only from customer subnets on port 443 (control plane) and 9000 (runtime internal) from our infra account.
- Private DNS: recommend split-horizon, add CNAMEs for control plane endpoints.

KMS/HSM checklist:
- Support paths: (1) AWS CloudHSM via KMS custom key store (preferred), (2) YubiHSM with proxy (customer testing).
- Need to validate key policies allow Redwood service principal: arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/redwood-control-plane (ask infra to confirm exact ARN).
- Test vector: encrypt/decrypt sample model secret, verify envelope encryption flow.

Configuration snippet (for onboarding doc; use as working reference):
- customer_id: glacier-asset-mgmt
- region: eu-west-1
- deployment_mode: private
- vpc_cidr: 10.12.0.0/16  # provisional until customer confirms
- control_plane_endpoint: https://glacier-rw-controlplane.internal
- kms_key_alias: alias/glacier-rw-kms
- audit_log_bucket: s3://glacier-rw-audit-logs

Runtime considerations and quantization/model selection:
- Customer needs deterministic outputs for compliance -> avoid stochastic sampling on critical routes. Set temperature=0.0 for regulatory responses.
- Start with open-weights Llama-derived 7B quantized to q4_0 for cost baseline, evaluate quality on their prompt corpus.
- If quality gap: consider moving to 13B quantized or Redwood-verified 13B float variant on Dedicated.

Rollout plan (POC -> prod):
- POC: single AZ private cluster, restricted access, synthetic load tests + customer integration tests.
- Canary: 5% traffic to new model variant for 48h, monitor latency and quality metrics.
- Full prod: regional multi-AZ, SLA 99.9% monthly uptime target, autoscaling policies defined.

To-dos & owners (actionable):
- [ ] Marco: get CloudHSM admission request + approval path (due 2026-02-25)
- [ ] Samira: prepare prompt eval set (50 regulatory examples + 200 typical chats) and run baseline (due 2026-02-23)
- [ ] Leah: provision staging VPC + route table for peering test (done 2026-02-21) -> verify routes
- [ ] Infra: confirm Redwood service principal ARN and update KMS policies (JIRA-GLACIER-45)
- [ ] Legal: confirm audit retention uplift (target decision by 2026-02-28)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Need a short troubleshooting doc for customer SREs: how to rotate KMS keys, update key alias without downtime.
- Consider adding 'read-only' access roles for their compliance team to view request traces (no PII).
- We should capture sample prompts that trigger hallucination on 7B baseline so research can evaluate fine-tuning vs retrieval augmentation.

Open questions (to escalate):
- Do they require model weights to be air-gapped on-prem (they said no for POC, but may change). If yes -> different pricing + timeline.
- Which exact CloudHSM HSM type (v2 cluster?) and who will manage (customer or Redwood infra)?
- Audit log format: customer requested a CSV export; current system exports JSON. Quick win: add small conversion lambda.

Quick links / references (working):
- Confluence: /display/SE/Glacier+Onboarding  (CONFLUENCE-GLACIER-ONBOARDING)
- Jira: GLACIER-45 (KMS + HSM integration)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/312 - private control plane changes

Last quick test results (2026-02-22):
- 7B q4 baseline: 95p latency = 210ms (single AZ), mean = 110ms under 20 req/s. Memory pressure: ~6.2GB per replica (w/ kernel caching).
- Embedding route (128-d): 99p latency = 140ms. Need to tune batching window to reduce cost.

Immediate next steps for tomorrow:
- Run evaluation set with system prompt variations (Samira)
- Lock down KMS policy draft and schedule 30m call with customer sec (Marco + Leah)
- Prepare short one-pager for customer on expected performance/cost tradeoffs between 7B q4 and 13B q4

----
Notes are messy — intentionally. Keep iterating.
